title: Revision of Standardisation Regulation 1025/2012 – what does it mean for the IT sector in Europe?
content: OpenForum Europe (OFE) welcomes the publication of the European Commission’s proposal for the new Regulation on European Standardisation, repealing the Standardisation Regulation 1025/2012. With this review, the European Commission is keeping its ambitions high, looking to overhaul key elements of the standardisation system and to make it more easily accessible to a number of stakeholders. This includes open source organisations and communities engaged in standardisation work, who will see to significantly benefit from the proposal. The revision is a welcome step in the right direction. OFE has long been actively engaged in the European discourse on standardisation and over the decades provided several contributions on improving the processes for standardisation in Europe. OFE will support the co-legislators in developing this proposal into law.
